'''Thull Wulain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sun Guard]] who was aided by the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] in his ascendancy to the rank of [[Supreme Sun Guardian]], swearing fealty to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Ancient Coruscant" />
